name: dawa
description: دعوة — wedding-invitation distribution app (root orchestrator; app code lives in frontend/ and backend/)

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only database,firestore,storage --project demo-dawa-test "vitest run -c backend/vitest.config.js --project integration"
scripts.test:watch: firebase emulators:exec --only database,firestore,storage --project demo-dawa-test "vitest -c backend/vitest.config.js --project integration"
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix frontend run test:unit && vitest run -c backend/vitest.config.js --project unit
scripts.test:api: node backend/scripts/build-functions.cjs && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database,firestore,storage,functions --project dawa-aa793 "node backend/scripts/seed-emulator.cjs && vitest run -c backend/vitest.config.js --project api"
